name: What is the average cost to install cement stucco per square foot in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to install cement stucco per square foot in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of cement stucco installation in Pasadena typically ranges from $7 to $15 per square foot, though this can vary. Factors influencing the price include the type of stucco system (e.g., traditional three-coat vs. one-coat), wall preparation required, the complexity of the architectural design, access to the work area, and the chosen finish texture and color. Obtaining a detailed quote from a local contractor is recommended for an accurate estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cement stucco installation in Pasadena generally costs $7 to $15 per square foot, depending on the system, preparation, and design complexity.
